messages:
marie: Quick async pulse for region incubation (ap-south-2). Need short status updates on milestones, owners for routing policy, data residency sign-off, PRs to review, and any infra blockers. Planning a brief sync tomorrow 10:00am PT — please drop one-line updates here. @aj @samir @zoe

aj: Routing policy status: PR #4123 merged to staging. Waiting on legal egress clause before promoting. Draft policy in docs: https://confluence/redwood/ap-south-2-routing. ETA for legal sign-off: EOD Tue.

samir: Infra update: VPC peering ✅ in infra account. Hit NAT gateway quota limit in prod account — opened cloud-support ticket CS-8765. If quota not approved in time, we can use shared NAT for initial canary. Also preparing terraform change for subnet tagging (PR #4201).

zoe: Data residency/compliance: uploaded dataflow diagram + retention matrix to Confluence (see link above). Legal asked for explicit KMS and logs residency statements. Need @elena to confirm KMS key residency policy.

elena: Reviewed diagram. KMS policy draft LGTM, but add key rotation and least-privilege note. I'll push PR #4188 for the KMS policy and include rotation schedule. Also flagged logs: we should set log-routing=false for ap-south-2 until compliance clears cross-region logging. cc @ingress-sre

ingress-sre: Canary routing plan: route 5% traffic to ap-south-2 using traffic controller flag `region-incubation-canary`. Patch up: PR #4190. Need @aj to approve rate-limiting defaults before I roll. We're also validating header-based residency tags in the proxy.

aj: I'll review #4190 today. Proposed rate-limits for canary: burst=50, rps=10. If 50th p latency > 250ms we revert the flag. Also pinged ops for ephemeral test endpoint so SREs can warm caches.

samir: One more infra item: model-artifact sync uses S3 cross-region replication. Replication role missing iam:PassRole in dev account — PR #4201 adds the role fix. Mentioning because it blocks canary model loads.

marie: Action items I hear: - @aj approve #4190 (routing defaults) - @elena merge #4188 (KMS + rotation) - @samir follow up CS-8765 & land #4201 (NAT quota / IAM) - @zoe get legal sign-off on egress clause. I'll run the readiness checklist before tomorrow's sync and add these to agenda.

zoe: Legal want a short change to upload-service: block writes to eu-resident buckets from ap-south-2. I can carve a tiny middleware PR today (no infra change).

aj: Quick ask: can ops provide a test endpoint for the traffic controller? Pinging ops channel.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: build passed for branch `region-incubation` (sha: abc123). Smoke tests started.

marie: :thumbsup: thanks — please reply 'on it' under your name when you start a task so I can mark owners. I'll ping here if anything escalates before the meeting.

aj: on it :eyes:

samir: on it

zoe: on it

elena: on it

ingress-sre: will monitor canary once #4190 lands

marie: If anyone hits a blocker today, paste short logs or error codes here and I'll loop in SRE/infra.
